facts.fact: The municipal tourism record places Arco da Porta Nova on Rua D.Diogo de Sousa and links the opening in the city wall to the early-sixteenth-century initiative of Archbishop Diogo de Sousa. This is historical context for the gateway, not a claim that all present masonry dates to that opening.
facts.location: Main description, first paragraph; location line.

facts.fact: The record labels the public monument free to enter and presents it as a welcome into Braga. The guide treats it as a street-level gateway, not a tower climb or interior museum.

notes: The early gateway opening and the later monumental arch are not conflated. No fixed walking distance from the railway station is asserted.
